src/merged-pr-sweeper.lib.mjs.reason: The sweep tick returns the running sweep instead of starting a second one (`if (running) return running`).

src/router-auth-guard.lib.mjs.reason: The guard's check is a synchronous filesystem inspection; it cannot overlap itself.

src/router-maintenance.lib.mjs.reason: Passed through to startSidecarMaintenance, whose tick skips while the previous one is still in flight.

src/tool-retry.lib.mjs.reason: A countdown log line once a minute while a retry waits; starts no process.
